prompt: The Splice project {project} holds a silent screen recording of a two-step TextEdit tutorial. Markers name each step; the attempt marked 'retake:' was redone later and must not appear. Cut it into a tight tutorial: keep each real step with its actions, drop the retake attempt and the idle time between steps. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: step 1 kept
checks.expr: any(c['source'] <= 3 * project['fps'] < c['source'] + c['length'] * c['speed'] for c in take_clips())

checks.name: step 2 kept
checks.expr: any(c['source'] <= 28 * project['fps'] < c['source'] + c['length'] * c['speed'] for c in take_clips())

checks.name: retake dropped
checks.expr: not any(c['source'] <= 15 * project['fps'] < c['source'] + c['length'] * c['speed'] for c in take_clips())

checks.name: idle cut
checks.expr: sum(c['length'] for c in take_clips()) < 24 * project['fps']
